titulo: Charity watchdog to criticise ‘intimidation’ after Farage calls for prosecution of groups helping asylum seekers – UK politics live
cuerpo: Charity commissioner to use speech to say there is a difference between ‘heated discussion’ and harassment or abuse Healey is meeting with UK journalists now at the IMF in Bangkok, including my colleague Heather Stewart . The August print- a 0.1% growth instead of the predicted 0.1% contraction – would have been very welcome news this morning, but he still faces a major challenge trying to find cash going into his 28 October budget. “I don’t want anybody to try and read in or second guess what [we may] do in two weeks’ time. My observations on the banks are just that people too often see them as a big distant financial institutions, when they are hardwired into the economic fabric of this country and our future prospects. “I’m pleased the IMF here in Bangkok have backed our economic plans in London. They say the UK stands out on growth despite the deep economic shocks that are affecting worldwide at present. They say Britain stands out on our plans to get to grips with the big borrowing costs by previous governments. They also say it’s important to stay the path, and I will follow that as I prepare my budget in two weeks’ time.” Continue reading...
